title: Creating buckets
text:
## Naming
A bucket name must be 3 to 63 characters long. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. Names are global, so a name used by another account is unavailable.

## Regions
You choose the region when you create a bucket. The region cannot be changed later. To move data to another region, create a new bucket and copy the objects.

title: Object versioning
text:
## Enabling versioning
Versioning keeps every version of an object in the same bucket. Once enabled, versioning can be suspended but never fully disabled.

## Restoring an old version
Overwriting an object creates a new version. Deleting an object adds a delete marker instead of removing data. To restore an overwritten or deleted object, copy the previous version over the current one or remove the delete marker.

title: Lifecycle rules
text:
## Transitions
A lifecycle rule can move objects to the cold tier after a number of days. Cold storage is cheaper per GB-month but charges a retrieval fee.

## Expiration
Rules can also expire noncurrent versions after a number of days and abort incomplete multipart uploads after seven days. Rules run once a day.

title: Retention lock
text:
## Compliance mode
In compliance mode an object cannot be deleted or overwritten until its retention date, not even by an administrator. Use it for records that regulators require you to keep unchanged.

## Governance mode
In governance mode, users with the bypass permission can delete locked objects. Retention lock requires versioning on the bucket.

title: Encryption
text:
## At rest
Every object is encrypted at rest with AES-256 by default. You can supply customer-managed keys from your key service instead of the default keys.

## In transit
All API endpoints require TLS 1.2 or newer. Plain HTTP requests are rejected with error E403.

title: Access keys
text:
## Creating keys
An access key has an id and a secret. The secret is shown only once, when the key is created. Each user can hold two active access keys.

## Rotation
Rotate access keys every 90 days. Create the second key, deploy it to your applications, then deactivate and delete the old key. Holding two keys makes rotation possible without downtime.

title: Request rate limits
text:
## Limits per prefix
Each prefix supports 3,500 write requests and 5,500 read requests per second. Spread hot keys across several prefixes to scale beyond that.

## Throttling
When a client exceeds the limit the service returns HTTP 429 with the code SlowDown. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter.

title: Error codes
text:
## Common codes
E403 AccessDenied means the key lacks permission or the request was not sent over TLS. E404 NoSuchKey means the object does not exist.

## Conflicts
E409 BucketNotEmpty is returned when you delete a bucket that still holds objects or object versions. Delete every object version and delete marker first.

title: Multipart upload
text:
## Large files
Use multipart upload for files larger than 100 MB. Each part is 5 MiB to 5 GiB, and one upload can have up to 10,000 parts. Parts can be sent in parallel and retried one at a time.

## Cleanup
Incomplete uploads keep their parts and are billed as storage. Add a lifecycle rule that aborts incomplete multipart uploads.

title: Cross-region replication
text:
## How replication works
Replication copies new objects from a source bucket to a bucket in another region. It is asynchronous, and most objects replicate within fifteen minutes.

## Requirements
Both buckets must have versioning enabled. Objects that existed before the rule was created are not replicated.

title: Pricing
text:
## Storage
Standard storage is billed per GB-month. The cold tier costs less per GB-month but adds a retrieval fee per GB read.

## Transfer
Uploads are free. Egress to the internet is billed per GB after the first 100 GB each month.

title: Support levels
text:
## Response targets
A P1 ticket gets a first response within 30 minutes, at any hour. A P2 ticket gets a response within four business hours.

## Escalation
The on-call storage engineer owns every P1 ticket until it is resolved or downgraded.

title: Runbook: elevated 5xx errors
text:
## Triage
Check the regional health dashboard first. If one zone is unhealthy, drain it from the load balancer.

## Failover
If the whole region is degraded, page the incident commander before starting regional failover.

title: Deleting buckets
text:
## Before you delete
A bucket must be empty before it can be deleted. With versioning enabled, empty means no current objects, no old versions and no delete markers.

## After deletion
A deleted bucket name may take up to 24 hours to become available again.

title: Presigned URLs
text:
## Temporary links
A presigned URL lets someone download one object without credentials. The link is signed with your access key and expires after at most seven days.

## Revoking a link
To revoke a presigned URL before it expires, deactivate the access key that signed it.

title: Account quotas
text:
## Default quotas
An account can create up to 100 buckets. There is no limit on the number of objects in a bucket.

## Raising a quota
Open a support ticket to request more buckets. Increases are reviewed within two business days.
